title: First throw final speed
description: Essential: Correctly computes the boat's speed after the first throw using momentum conservation, yielding v₁ = 270/295 m/s.

title: Direction reversal count
description: Essential: Correctly determines the number of throws (n=11) after which the boat's velocity becomes zero or negative.

title: 16th throw speed change
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the change in boat speed (Δv = 2/15 m/s) for the 16th throw with relative velocity.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation correctly for each scenario, distinguishing between velocities relative to shore and relative to the boat.

title: General velocity formula
description: Important: Derives or uses the correct expression for the boat's velocity after n throws in the shore-relative case (v_n = (300 - 30n)/(300 - 5n)).

title: Relative velocity handling
description: Important: For part (2), correctly expresses the thrown ball's shore velocity as (v_boat + v) when v is relative to the boat.

title: Sign error in reversal
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly solves the inequality for direction reversal (e.g., setting v_n > 0 instead of v_n ≤ 0) or makes an arithmetic mistake.

title: Mass accounting mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect total mass or remaining mass in the momentum equation for a given throw.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (kg, m/s) throughout calculations without conversion errors.
